app.name: MediBridge
app.tagline: Your medical records. Clear explanations. In your language.

auth.verifyEmailMessage: We sent a verification link to {email}. Please check your inbox and click the link to continue.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email for a password reset link.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.loginFailed: Sign in failed. Please check your email and password.
errors.signupFailed: Account creation failed. Please try again.
errors.resetFailed: Could not send reset email. Please try again.

records.title: My Records
records.uploadDescription: Upload a medical report, prescription, or other document (PDF, JPG, PNG — max 10 MB, 10 pages).
records.dragDrop: Drag and drop your file here, or click to browse
records.supported: Supported: PDF, JPG, PNG — max 10 MB, max 10 pages
records.empty: No records yet. Upload your first document to get started.

errors.fileTooLarge: This file is over 10 MB. Please use a smaller file.
errors.wrongType: Only PDF, JPG, and PNG files are accepted.
errors.tooManyPages: This document has more than 10 pages. Please split it before uploading.
errors.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Please remove the password before uploading.
errors.duplicate: You have already uploaded this document.
errors.nameMismatch: The patient name in this document ({name}) may be different from your profile. Please confirm before saving.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Please check that it is not corrupted.

actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this record? This cannot be undone. All extracted data, explanations, and schedules linked to this record will also be removed.

review.title: Review Extracted Data
review.unresolvedWarning: Some fields are unclear. Please review them before confirming.
review.confirmNote: This confirms you have checked the extracted data. It does not mean the data is clinically verified.

explanation.title: Understand My Report
explanation.questionsForAppointment: Questions to ask at your appointment
explanation.disclaimer: This explanation is for information only. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional medical advice.
explanation.notVerified: AI-generated explanations are not professionally verified translations.
explanation.outOfRange: This result is outside the printed reference range for this report. This is not a diagnosis.

errors.noData: No reviewed data found. Please review the extracted information first.
errors.providerUnavailable: Explanation service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.configMissing: Explanation service is not configured. Please contact support.

chat.title: Ask MediBridge
chat.noAnswer: Your records do not provide enough information to answer this question.
chat.contextTruncated: Note: only a portion of your records were included in this response.
chat.emergencyNotice: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please call emergency services immediately. MediBridge cannot provide emergency care.
chat.disclaimer: MediBridge does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional medical advice.
chat.providerUnavailable: The chat service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
chat.rateLimitExceeded: You have reached the daily message limit. Please try again tomorrow.
chat.empty: Ask a question about your medical records. For example: "What does my HbA1c result mean?" or "What were my results last month?"

errors.sendFailed: Could not send message. Please try again.
errors.noRecords: Please upload and review at least one record before asking questions.

schedule.title: My Schedule
schedule.noMedicines: No medicines scheduled. Confirm a reviewed prescription to add medicines to your schedule.
schedule.confirmCurrentlyTaking: Confirm you are currently taking this
schedule.disclaimer: This is an in-app checklist based on your reviewed prescriptions. It does not send reminders. Do not change doses without consulting your pharmacist or prescriber.
schedule.noRecommendation: If you have questions about doses or missed medicines, ask your pharmacist or prescriber.
schedule.clarificationNeeded: Some timing instructions are unclear. Please ask your pharmacist or prescriber before adding to schedule.

diary.title: My Diary
diary.empty: No diary entries yet. Add a symptom or note to keep track.
diary.disclaimer: Diary entries are patient-reported and do not imply a diagnosis or cause.

trends.title: Trends
trends.noCompatible: No compatible results found. Results must have the same test, unit, and specimen type to be compared.
trends.incompatibleNote: Results with different units or specimen types are shown separately.
trends.disclaimer: Trends show reviewed results only. Changes noted do not mean improvement or worsening. Consult your doctor for interpretation.

questions.title: My Questions
questions.empty: No saved questions. Save questions from explanations or chat, or add your own.

visitBrief.title: Visit Brief
visitBrief.disclaimer: This brief is based on your reviewed records. It is not a clinical document. Please review before sharing.
visitBrief.empty: No briefs yet. Generate one by selecting your records.
visitBrief.patientLabel: PATIENT-PREPARED VISIT BRIEF — NOT A CLINICAL DOCUMENT

home.title: My Next Steps
home.noTasks: No pending tasks. Upload a record to get started.

followups.title: My Follow-ups
followups.disclaimer: Follow-up dates are from your records. Please verify with your doctor or hospital.
followups.empty: No follow-ups recorded. Follow-up instructions from your documents will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNote: Changing language will update all app text and future explanations.
settings.deleteAccountWarning: Deleting your account removes all your records, data, and uploads permanently. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyNote: Your documents are stored privately. Uploads are processed by Google Gemini AI for data extraction. Conversations use the Groq API. Neither provider guarantees zero retention. See our privacy policy for details.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.synthetic: SYNTHETIC DEMO — NOT A REAL PATIENT
common.configError: This feature requires configuration. Please set up the required API keys.
common.providerError: The AI service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
common.disclaimer: MediBridge does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, or guarantee clinical accuracy. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.
